description:
One hop from a paper: every reference entry with its resolved work
    identity, the papers that cite it, and, where a record exists, the
    citing sentences with their labeled intent. An edge means the paper
    names the other work, not that the work supports the citing claim.

arxiv_id.description: Any form the user gave: bare arXiv id (2401.00001), arXiv abs/pdf URL, DOI or doi.org URL, or Pith Number.
arxiv_id.title: Arxiv Id

direction.description: out: works this paper cites. in: papers that cite it. both.
direction.title: Direction

name: citation_neighbors

outputSchema.description: One hop of the citation graph, record edges and graph edges kept apart.
outputSchema.title: CitationNeighbors

title: One hop of the citation graph
